native_flow.unit_definition: delegated to HYSYS; exact COM unit token needs remote validation

capability_combinations.note: Requires a defined feed basis and verification of solid-phase readback.

capability_combinations.reason: The attempted Gibbs Ln(K) source could not be set; no validated alternative.

reactor_kinds.conversion: Reaction equations plus a specified conversion. Needs reactions[].stoichiometry, conversion_percent (or conversion_coefficients) and base_component. VERIFIED on the workstation for a single fixed-conversion adiabatic toluene reaction; other combinations are not implied.
reactor_kinds.equilibrium: Reaction equations plus a K source. NOT USABLE on this workstation: the Gibbs Ln(K) source cannot be set (it stays FixedK=2), so the tool layer refuses this path rather than silently using a fixed K.
reactor_kinds.gibbs: No reaction equations. Product distribution comes from free energy minimisation. Needs the full candidate component list in fluid_package.components. Historically verified for fixed-temperature steam reforming; solid carbon is experimental.

flow_units.note: Default local conversion accepts molar/mass units. Explicit flow_input=hysys with flow_property=MolarFlow or MassFlow delegates the exact total_flow_unit to HYSYS SetValue/GetValue; unit support and absolute flow require remote validation.

thermal_modes: adiabatic (duty fixed at 0 kW, outlet T computed)
isothermal (outlet_temperature required; the reported duty includes sensible heating of the feed, not only the heat of reaction)

components.note: A component is passed to HYSYS under its library name, and reaction reactants are addressed by the name HYSYS reports back (water reads back as H2O), never by the requested spelling.

notes: One call builds one case and one operating condition. For several conditions, call once per condition.
Each run must use a NEW output folder. Reusing one makes HYSYS resolve the duplicate case file path against a case that is still open, and the "new" case then comes back non-blank.
Call --validate-only before --spec to check a specification offline in milliseconds.
